performance.verdict: Leads are a tracking ghost — GHL shows 46 opps but system reads zero.

findings.text: lead_drought flag is a tracking disconnect: 0 leads recorded over 28 days, yet GHL shows 46 opportunities created and 17 won. Ads are converting; the pixel is not.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 — no completed event recorded. Speed-to-lead automations unverified; Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7, intake seat may be empty.
Google spend is highly erratic: 0-spend days on 8/2–8/4, 8/6, 8/22, averaging only $20.82/day in the last 7d vs $41+/day in the prior 7d — a 50.52% drop with no Meta offset.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on the last 3 days (8/25–8/27) vs an average of 5.3/day over the prior 14 days — a 71.11% 7d drop that tracks alongside spend cuts, not independently.
Search clicks rose 41.67% week-over-week (5 clicks on 8/24, 5 on 8/25, 4 on 8/26) while GA4 sessions remain 0 across the entire 45-day series — GA4 is not firing at all.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking — 0 leads recorded vs 12 conversions and 46 GHL opps confirm a pixel disconnect.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads reports 12 conversions and GHL shows 46 opportunities created over 28 days, yet the lead counter reads zero — the conversion tag is firing but not syncing to the lead tracking layer. Audit the Google Ads tag implementation (likely a missing or misconfigured GHL webhook/form-submit event). Success is confirmed when daily leads in the system match GHL opportunity creation within ±2 units. Resolve by 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Confirm who owns GHL intake seat after Vivian's 7/7 departure and complete the booking bot battle-test overdue since 2026-07-31.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the speed-to-lead automations point at an unconfirmed seat; the booking bot battle-test required by 2026-07-31 has no completion record. Confirm with Xavier or Nader who now owns the GHL inbox and after-hours coverage, then run the battle-test checklist end-to-end. Success is a named owner with active GHL login and a passed bot test logged in the SOW sheet. Complete by 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Watch daily Google spend stabilise above $35/day for 3 consecutive days before any budget increase — erratic $0 days block scaling gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Google spend averaged only $20.82/day in the last 7 days with five zero-spend days in the 45-day series. The SOW scale-back-up gate explicitly prohibits raising budgets until the intake seat and tracking issues are resolved. Monitor daily spend; if three consecutive days each exceed $35 and F1/F2 fixes are confirmed, bring the budget increase recommendation to Sohib for approval. Re-check 2026-09-01.
